reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and adds a shared isNonWorkingDay used everywhere, and the new range handler reuses recurConfigToRSchedule/RSchedule, but the daily skip-versus-move decision is not put in a shared function that all callers use.

duplication.why: The 'daily skips, others move' rule is written separately in getNextDate (shared/schedules.ts), applyWeekendHandling plus a second skipsWeekendDays in getUpcomingDates (schedules/app.ts), and via an isDaily flip of noSkipWeekend in schedule-template.ts, each with its own occurrence-window sizing.

placement.why: isNonWorkingDay and the holiday-aware solver sit correctly in shared/schedules.ts, but applyWeekendHandling, a general weekend rule, lives in the server schedules app instead of next to them, and schedule-template encodes the rule by flipping a getNextDate flag.

scope.why: Changes track the four steps; the schedule-template loop restructure is part of making daily skipping work there.

maintainability.why: A change to the weekend/holiday rule must now be repeated in three places with three different window heuristics (MAX_DAILY_OCCURRENCE_SCAN, (count + holidays) * 7, WEEKEND_SHIFT_DAYS + 2 * holidays).

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedules/app.ts applyWeekendHandling/getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template.ts (isDaily passed as noSkipWeekend, own skipWeekend ternary) decide skip-vs-move themselves instead of sharing getNextDate's logic.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily skip / move decision of getNextDate is reshaped as applyWeekendHandling (filter+map) in schedules/app.ts and as a `!isDaily` noSkipWeekend argument in schedule-template.ts.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter; getNextDate gains a daily-frequency special case (skipsWeekendDays/movesWeekend with a widened take); applyWeekendHandling in schedules/app.ts and the isDaily path in budget/schedule-template.ts re-implement that decision.
